applied.old: output a table of (A_i, F^(-m)(x_i), s_i, y_i, m) for every training composition.
applied.new: output a table of (A_i, F^(-m)(x_i), s_i, y_i, m) for every training composition and every candidate (rho, h, k_nn, tau) that step 8 searches over.
applied.why: Step 8 selects rho, h, k_nn and tau over candidates on these instances, and core_mechanism says 'Lambda, h, k_nn, rho and tau are fit or selected by minimising the realised loss ... on these instances', so the table must be built once per candidate.

applied.old: deployment-matched instances on which to learn where the correction must switch off
applied.new: deployment-matched instances on which to learn where the correction must be damped toward zero (and whether grouped CV selects it at zero)
applied.why: Agrees with core_mechanism's revised switch-off definition ('shrinks toward 0 but need not reach it'; 'switches off means is selected at 0 by the grouped CV') and the R2-aligned DSBM delta.

applied.old: it learns where to switch off from manufactured deployment-matched instances
applied.new: it learns where to damp the correction toward zero from manufactured deployment-matched instances
applied.why: Same R2 switch-off precision as core_mechanism and differentiation_from_lit[6].delta.
